name: Bollinger Band Fade
thesis: A close beyond a Bollinger band is a statistical overextension of the recent distribution; the close back inside the band marks the moment the impulse that caused it has been absorbed, and price reverts toward the mean.
invalidation: Demote if win rate is below 40% over 15 trades or profit factor below 1.0 over 20.

provenance.note: Exact port of eval_bb_fade's pierce-and-reclaim (0.998 bar agreement with the filter removed, zero legacy-only bars). Fires ~60% less often than the legacy family because of the ADDED adx(14) < 25 filter: the legacy evaluator has no regime gate at all, so it fades bands inside strong trends. That is a deliberate change, not a porting delta.
